pages.name: Scotch Game: Scotch Gambit, Cochrane-Anderssen Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 had White push d4-d5 with no d-pawn (d4 is Black's pawn); now cxd4 first. British spelling in plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: Scotch Game: Scotch Gambit, London Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 supported a d4-d5 push with no White d-pawn; rewrote it around 5.c3, offering a second pawn. Plan 3's notation fixed. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Scotch Game: Sea-Cadet Mate
pages.notes: The overview called the final mate smothered (it is a knights-and-bishop mate on e7); plan 4 recommended ...Be7 in a mated position. Rewrote both: the real error was 7...Ne5, since 8...dxe5 9.Qxg4 also costs a piece. Plan 1 clarified.

pages.name: Scotch: Cochrane Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had White's plan start with Black's Kxf7 and the 'open e-file' (White's e4-pawn is on it); rewrote it around e5, the c4-bishop pinning the e6-knight and the queen via f3 or h5 (a first version with the queen via d5, covered by the c6-pawn, was rejected).

pages.name: Scotch Game: Horwitz Attack, Blackburne Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Bg5 after White's dark-squared bishop has been traded on d2; now N1c3 and Bf3 against the e4-queen.

pages.name: Scotch Game: Malaniuk Variation
pages.notes: Plans 1, 3 and 4 built on a White pawn centre, Black's ...dxc3 and a d4-pawn that don't exist (White's d-pawn has gone, d4 holds a knight); rewrote all four plans.

pages.name: Scotch Game: Meitner Variation
pages.notes: The overview and plans 1-2 had the c5-bishop capturing a knight on c2 and a 'b-file' afterwards; rewrote them around 7...Bxe3 8.Nxe3 or 7...Bb6.

pages.name: Scotch Game: Romanishin Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1's Maroczy-bind claim and plan 2's White c3 in Black's plan rewritten. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Scotch Game: Tartakower Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed the d2-knight via f1-g3 with the bishop on f1; rewrote it (a first version claiming the knight would support e4 from f3 or b3 was rejected). British spelling in the overview and plans 1 and 2.

pages.name: Scotch: 4.Nxd4 Bc5 5.Be3 Qf6 6.c3 Nge7
pages.notes: The overview and plan 2 named a d4-pawn that is a knight; plan 3 had Bg5 pinning an f6-knight (the queen is on f6, the bishop already on e3); plan 4's ...a5-a4 against b2-b4 replaced with ...d5 or ...O-O and ...d6.
